project_name.justification: The article is titled "Fireweed Announces Signing of Definitive Agreement on Mactung Project" and refers to the acquisition of the "Mactung Tungsten Project".

company_name.justification: The press release is from "FIREWEED METALS CORP. (“Fireweed” or the “Company”) (TSXV: FWZ; OTCQB: FWEDF, formerly Fireweed Zinc Ltd.)".

ceo_buyer.justification: The article includes a statement from "Brandon Macdonald, CEO" and is signed "ON BEHALF OF FIREWEED METALS CORP. “Brandon Macdonald” CEO & Director".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states Fireweed signed a "definitive Asset Purchase Agreement for the acquisition of 100% interest in the Mactung Tungsten Project".

primary_commodity.justification: The project is consistently referred to as the "Mactung Tungsten Project" and is described as "one of the largest and highest-grade tungsten deposits in the world".

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the Mactung project acquisition by Fireweed Metals, but no URL is provided in the source text.

currency.justification: The text specifies the purchase price in Canadian dollars: "...a total purchase price of C$15,000,000...".

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total purchase price is stated as "C$15,000,000", which is composed of four staged cash payments: $1,500,000, $3,500,000, $5,000,000, and another $5,000,000.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms outlined in the document only mention cash payments. There is no mention of share payments as part of the acquisition consideration.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The payment terms are explicitly broken down into cash payments. Per the extraction hierarchy, this field is null when explicit cash values are available.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: No shares were issued as part of the acquisition agreement with the Government of Northwest Territories.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The agreement terms do not include any share warrant payments.

option_payments_raw.justification: The text mentions a grant of stock options, but specifies they are for "staff members including the new Corporate Secretary" and not part of the Mactung project acquisition consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the acquisition agreement, so there is no issued share price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The agreement terms do not mention any exploration commitment in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The agreement terms do not mention any monetary exploration commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The text states 'Mactung carries an existing net smelter return royalty (“NSR”) of 4%, which is held by a third party'. This is a pre-existing condition of the asset and not a royalty acquired or retained as part of the transaction terms between Fireweed and the GNWT.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states: "Fireweed has signed a definitive Asset Purchase Agreement and acquired 100% interest in the 37.6 km2 Mactung Tungsten Project..."

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text states: "Fireweed has signed a definitive Asset Purchase Agreement and acquired 100% interest in the 37.6 km2 Mactung Tungsten Project..."
